fields.description: Sheet role in the master template. 'data' = a normal trade sheet (grid_and_nodes on create); 'general_specs' = a general-specifications reference sheet (grid_only; its content is carried in preamble_text). Mirrors BoQ Committed Sheet Grid.sheet_disposition semantics (ADR-0013 A1).
fields.label: Disposition

fields.description: Per-sheet parse config (header_row, header_row_count, column_role_map, column_headers, area_dimensions), NORMALIZED to single-area at seed time (one quantity column, no qty_by_area). Re-emitted verbatim onto the created BoQ Sheet Draft.sheet_config by Create-from-Template.
fields.label: Sheet Config

fields.description: JSON array of work_header names (Work Headers link values). A JSON field -- NOT a grandchild Table -- to dodge Frappe's one-level child serialization limit (a sheet is already a child of BoQ Template).
fields.label: Work Packages

fields.description: For disposition = general_specs: the extracted preamble text, used to seed the single grid_only cell row on commit. Blank for data sheets.
fields.label: Preamble Text
